capabilities: Create parent, child, sibling and orphan notes via buttons and commands
Generate folder structures mirroring the note hierarchy
Set generation properties and cluster tags on created notes
Delete notes together with their empty folders and child notes
Delete the current line with a button for phone users
disambiguation: Not data or AI clustering; it creates manual parent-child note hierarchies via folders, links and tags.
extras: Requires two folders (CLUSTERS and ORPHANS) inside the vault; suggests hotkey bindings on PC; ends with a buy-me-a-coffee support link.
problem: Creating and maintaining hierarchical note structures with links, folders and properties is tedious, especially on mobile.
summary: Note-clustering tool that builds parent-child note hierarchies with buttons, commands, folders, tags and generation properties.
